title: Starter Villain
author: John Scalzi
summary: Charlie is a divorced substitute teacher with money problems who inherits his uncle's business, which turns out to be a supervillain operation. His staff includes talking cats and other surprising colleagues.
readIf: you want a quick, silly, sharp comedy with talking animals and wry jabs at billionaires.
skipIf: you want serious science fiction or deep characterisation, since it is a light, playful romp.

pairings.reason: The model for comic science fiction in which absurd ideas are played completely straight.
A very British comic fantasy with the same love of mischief and an unlikely partnership.
A longer, more violent comedy with a snarky talking cat and a very strange premise.
